state: A customer wrote to ask where their order is. Nothing has been looked up yet, and the message carries an order number.
The order was found. It shipped nine days ago and the carrier's tracking has not moved for six days. The customer has not been told anything yet.
The carrier confirmed in writing that the parcel is lost. The customer replied that they still want the item and do not want their money back.

actions.ship_a_replacement: Send the same item again at no charge.
actions.refund_the_order: Give the money back and send nothing.
actions.open_a_carrier_claim: Ask the carrier to investigate the parcel.
actions.close_the_ticket: End the conversation with no further action.
